issue.title: Agent team communication and peer consensus protocol

tasks.description: Add ConsensusPhase enum (WORKING, PROPOSED, REVIEWING, CONFIRMED) to shared/egg_orchestrator/types.py. Add consensus message type constants (CONSENSUS_PROPOSE, CONSENSUS_ACK, CONSENSUS_NACK, CONSENSUS_WITHDRAW, CONSENSUS_CONFIRMED) to MessageType in both shared/egg_orchestrator/types.py and orchestrator/message_store.py.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ConsensusPhase enum exists with 4 values; 5 consensus message types in both MessageType locations; existing types unchanged; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Create orchestrator/attestation_schemas.py with per-role attestation Pydantic models (CoderAttestation, TesterAttestation, DocumenterAttestation, ReviewerCodeAttestation, ReviewerContractAttestation, CheckerAttestation) plus ProposalPayload and ReviewPayload wrappers that validate non-empty artifact references
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All 6 attestation models serialize/deserialize; ProposalPayload/ReviewPayload reject empty artifact refs; configurable strictness; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Create orchestrator/review_graph.py with ReviewEdge (reviewer_role, producer_role, criticality), ReviewGraph (edges, reviewers_for, producers_for, is_reviewer, is_producer, critical_reviewers_for). Define default implement-phase review graph per issue spec.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Default graph matches spec (~7-10 edges); lookup methods correct; tester dual-role handled; configurable per phase; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Create orchestrator/approval_matrix.py with ApprovalMatrix class — record_ack, record_nack, is_fully_acked, is_fully_confirmed, get_blocking_edges, invalidate_ack (scoped re-evaluation), revision_count per edge. Serializable to/from dict.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ACK/NACK tracking per edge correct; is_fully_acked checks all assigned reviewers; invalidate_ack works; revision_count tracks per-edge; serialization round-trips; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Extend consensus event types in orchestrator/events.py. CONSENSUS_REACHED and CONSENSUS_TIMEOUT already exist — do not re-add. Add new: CONSENSUS_PROPOSE_RECEIVED, CONSENSUS_ACK_RECEIVED, CONSENSUS_NACK_RECEIVED, CONSENSUS_CONFIRMED_RECEIVED, CONSENSUS_WITHDRAW_RECEIVED, CONSENSUS_FAILURE.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: New event types added without duplicating existing ones; events can be created and emitted; existing events unchanged; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Create orchestrator/redis_message_store.py with RedisMessageStore backed by Redis Streams (key pipeline:{id}:messages). XADD for writes, XREAD for reads with since_id cursor, Python-side role filtering. Connection pooling via get_redis_message_store() singleton. Graceful connection failure handling.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Same interface as MessageStore; messages persist across restarts; role filtering correct; connection pool configured; connection failure raises clear error; unit tests with real Redis pass

tasks.description: Add long-polling to GET /<pipeline_id>/messages in orchestrator/routes/messages.py. New wait query param (seconds, max 60, default 0). When wait > 0, use XREAD BLOCK, apply role filter, return on match or timeout. Implementation note: check production WSGI server config (gunicorn gevent vs sync workers) — XREAD BLOCK for 30s will block an entire sync worker.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: wait=0 backwards compatible; wait=30 blocks and returns on message arrival; timeout returns empty list; server responsive during blocking reads; unit/integration tests pass

tasks.description: Wire RedisMessageStore into application. Update get_message_store() to use Redis when available, in-memory fallback for tests. Add Redis config (host, port, db). Clean up Redis Stream key on pipeline deletion.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Redis backend in production; in-memory fallback for tests; pipeline deletion cleans keys; existing message tests pass; no behavior change for non-consensus messages

tasks.description: Create orchestrator/peer_consensus.py with PeerConsensusTracker — per-agent ConsensusPhase tracking, ReviewGraph, ApprovalMatrix. Handlers for propose/ack/nack/withdraw/confirmed with attestation validation. evaluate() checks all-confirmed → emit CONSENSUS_REACHED. Tester dual-role: track both producer state (WORKING→PROPOSED→CONFIRMED) and reviewer state (WORKING→REVIEWING→CONFIRMED) simultaneously; tester confirmed only when both reach CONFIRMED. Wire into message handling dispatch.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: State transitions follow spec; tester dual-role both state machines tracked; attestation validation rejects empty refs; events emitted; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Add scoped re-evaluation to PeerConsensusTracker. On re-proposal, compare changed artifacts against existing ACK artifact refs. Overlap → invalidate ACK. No overlap → ACK stands. NACKing reviewer always re-reviews.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Overlapping ACKs invalidated; non-overlapping preserved; NACKing reviewer always re-reviews; example scenario (rev_code NACKs coder auth.py, tester ACK on tests stands) works; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Add commitment devices — cooldown after PROPOSED (configurable, default 30s), withdrawal requires reason, lockout after K flip-flops (default 3), bounded revision rounds per edge (default 2) with HITL escalation on limit
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cooldown rejects early withdrawal; empty reason rejected; lockout triggers after K flips; revision limit triggers HITL; all configurable; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Add consensus failure handlers — partial timeout (evaluate blocking edges by criticality, escalate critical, proceed non-critical), agent crash (producer crash preserves proposal, reviewer crash removes from graph and re-evaluates)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Timeout with critical blocker creates HITL with matrix snapshot; non-critical proceeds; producer crash preserves proposal; reviewer crash removes edge; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Replace ConsensusEvaluator in orchestrator/concurrent_executor.py with PeerConsensusTracker. Initialize with phase review graph. Register edges on spawn. Listen for CONSENSUS_REACHED/TIMEOUT/FAILURE. Pass review assignments to agents via env vars.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: ConcurrentPhaseExecutor uses PeerConsensusTracker; review graph registered; phase completes on CONSENSUS_REACHED; timeout/failure handled; agents get review assignments in env; existing tests updated and passing

tasks.description: Update orchestrator/routes/signals.py with consensus signal handlers (propose, ack, nack, withdraw, confirmed). Validate payloads against attestation schemas. Dispatch to PeerConsensusTracker. Write to Redis Stream. Deprecate readiness signal handler.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each consensus signal handled correctly; attestation validation rejects invalid payloads; messages written to stream; readiness handler deprecated with clear error; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Add Delphi visibility filtering to message poll endpoint in orchestrator/routes/messages.py. When requester is a reviewer for a proposer and hasn't submitted ACK/NACK yet (checked via approval matrix), withhold CONSENSUS_PROPOSE from that proposer. Release after reviewer submits evaluation.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reviewer without prior evaluation doesn't see PROPOSE; after ACK/NACK sees it; non-reviewers see PROPOSE immediately; git artifacts unaffected; integration tests pass

tasks.description: Update all remaining ConsensusEvaluator call sites beyond concurrent_executor.py (TASK-3-5): (1) orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py:968 — pipeline status endpoint must read from PeerConsensusTracker returning BRC phase per agent + approval matrix (critical: consensus_wrapper.py reads this via egg-orch pipeline status --json); (2) orchestrator/routes/phases.py:98 — clear PeerConsensusTracker state on phase completion; (3) orchestrator/consensus.py — remove or deprecate old ConsensusEvaluator class.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Pipeline status returns BRC state (per-agent phase, approval matrix, review graph); phase completion clears tracker; old ConsensusEvaluator removed/deprecated; wrapper can read BRC state via API; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Add consensus subcommand group to sandbox/egg_lib/orch_cli.py — propose (with attestations), ack <role>, nack <role>, withdraw, status (approval matrix + review graph). Support --json and structured JSON payloads.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Commands invoke correct endpoints; payload validation catches missing fields; status shows clear matrix; help text documents per-role attestation requirements; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Add --wait <seconds> flag to egg-orch message poll in sandbox/egg_lib/orch_cli.py. Makes blocking HTTP request with wait query param. Backwards compatible (--wait 0 = current behavior).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: --wait 30 blocks until messages arrive; timeout returns cleanly; backwards compatible; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Add consensus client methods to shared/egg_orchestrator/client.py (consensus_propose, consensus_ack, consensus_nack, consensus_withdraw, consensus_status) and corresponding types to shared/egg_orchestrator/types.py
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Client methods call correct endpoints; types serialize/deserialize; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Rework orchestrator/consensus_wrapper.py for BRC. Detect BRC phase on agent exit (WORKING/PROPOSED/REVIEWING/CONFIRMED) via orchestrator API (egg-orch consensus status --json or egg-orch pipeline status --json with BRC data from TASK-3-8), NOT direct Redis access — the wrapper is a bash script and should not have a Redis dependency. Generate phase-appropriate recovery prompts with missed messages from API. CONFIRMED agents not restarted. Preserve max restart limit.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: BRC phase detected via orchestrator API (not Redis); recovery prompts phase-appropriate with missed messages; CONFIRMED not restarted; max restart limit preserved; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Update concurrent execution instructions in sandbox/.claude/rules/mission.md (the 'Concurrent Execution Mode' section, not the top-level CLAUDE.md). Replace READY/poll-loop with BRC protocol. Separate producer vs reviewer sections. Per-role attestation requirements with examples. Anti-sycophancy measures. Long-polling replaces sleep loops.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Producer/reviewer workflows clearly separated; attestation requirements per role with examples; anti-sycophancy explicit; long-polling replaces sleep; under 4000 tokens for consensus section

tasks.description: Add consensus events to SSE streaming in orchestrator/sse.py and orchestrator/unified_sse.py. Include approval matrix state in status events for DAG visualizer.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Consensus events in SSE stream; approval matrix in status payloads; existing consumers not broken; unit tests pass

tasks.description: Create orchestrator/tests/test_peer_consensus_integration.py — happy path (propose→ACK→confirm→reached), NACK+re-propose with scoped re-eval, Delphi ordering, timeout with critical role, agent crash, commitment devices, Redis Streams persistence/replay/long-polling latency
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All scenarios pass with real Redis; timing assertions verify <2s delivery; full BRC lifecycle exercised

tasks.description: Update existing test files (test_consensus.py, test_consensus_wrapper.py, test_concurrent_executor.py, test_messages.py) for new protocol. Remove deprecated READY-tallying tests. Add BRC integration points. Ensure make test passes clean.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All existing test files updated; no READY-tallying references; BRC integration points covered; make test passes

tasks.description: Create sandbox/.claude/rules/integrator.md (file does not currently exist — integrator instructions are inline in mission.md concurrent mode section; extract and expand). Add attestation verification: cross-reference commit SHAs, file modifications, test existence. NACK on discrepancy. Escalate after K false re-proposals.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: integrator.md created with verification steps; failure escalation documented; unit test for verification logic passes

tasks.description: Update _build_agent_prompt() in orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py:3046-3070. This function injects the 'CRITICAL: Concurrent Consensus Protocol' preamble at spawn time (the 5-step BOOTSTRAP/EXECUTE/SIGNAL READY/STAY ALIVE/WAIT FOR STOP lifecycle). Rewrite for BRC: inject whether agent is producer or reviewer (from review graph), which roles it reviews/is reviewed by, BRC lifecycle steps for its role type, and attestation requirements for its specific role.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Agents receive BRC preamble not old READY lifecycle; preamble is role-type-aware (producer vs reviewer); no contradictions with rules files (TASK-5-1); unit tests pass
